method: Every PDF was opened for full-text extraction and item-marker/risk scanning. Content-based teaching roles were assigned after reviewing assignment prompts and quiz item samples by topic. These are captured assignment/quiz pages, not standalone explanatory readings. Eight page-one assignment selections are now supporting learner resources after complete in-course modelling; the remaining 63 are not selected learner readings. Adapted tasks use fictional profiles. Final teacher review remains required.
collectionFinding: All 71 PDFs are captured assignment or quiz pages. Eight assignment page-one selections are now integrated as supporting original resources after lesson teaching, with image and accessible HTML fallbacks; the remaining 63 are not required learner readings.
